conclusions: The deployed weights exactly match the recorded eight-direction distillation run.
The recorded loader uses a -0.44m teacher-to-student reference offset and directional teacher patches; its comments explicitly preserve an image-y convention.

The locally supplied label generator includes progress, roll/pitch safety, time and lateral-error conditions, and separate static negatives. A low score alone does not identify which condition failed.
limits: The generator file is a candidate source, not independently reconstructed per-sample provenance. Raw simulation trajectories needed to recreate labels are missing.
A forward-motion classifier is not an independently validated static-stability or reverse-driving classifier.
Do not silently change pose anchors, remove footprint dilation, average directions or waive blocked starts from this audit alone. A coordinate/polarity and physical footprint validation is required.

simulation_direction_contract.note: Captured-map regressions verify software under this configured contract; the calibration flag alone is not new measured direction-calibration evidence.
